question: What benefits result from sustained practice of this soul-knowledge?
premises: The practitioner becomes free from all diseases
The practitioner gains association with yogis
These are outcomes of the prescribed practice
inference: Such practice leads to freedom from all diseases and union with yogis.
uncertainties: saha+melakam may mean meeting, companionship, or mystical union
plain_english: ...becomes freed from all diseases and attains union with the yogis.
